name: release
description: Cut a release: verify readiness, draft notes from git, review, then publish only when approved.

stages.name: readiness
stages.task:
Run the CI gate for this release (lint/build/test). Report the verdict as the last line, exactly 'CI: PASS' or 'CI: FAIL'.

{task}

stages.name: notes
stages.task:
Given a green build, determine the semantic version bump and draft the changelog/release notes FROM THE ACTUAL GIT LOG since the last tag. Group by feat/fix/breaking. State the reasoning for the version bump.
{stage.readiness}

stages.name: review
stages.task:
Review the proposed version and changelog for accuracy against the real diff since the last tag. If correct and complete, reply with APPROVED; otherwise reply NEEDS_CHANGES with specifics.
{deps}

stages.name: publish
stages.task:
Prepare the release: tag name, artifacts, and publish steps. Per your safety rules, do NOT tag/publish/deploy without explicit Owner approval - present the ready-to-run plan and stop.
{stage.notes}
